name: cam_recommend_process
description: 工艺四元组推荐：给定加工特征(feature，如 face/hole/profile)与材料(material)，仅返回有效人工批准且符合现场条件的钻孔工艺。conditions包含tool、hardness_hrc、diameter_mm、depth_mm、coolant(dry/flood/mist/through_tool)、workholding(vise/chuck/fixture/collet)。缺少或不符时返回缺失/不符项，禁止补造参数。仍需物理校验
inputs: {'feature': {'title': 'Feature', 'type': 'string', 'description': 'see tool description'}, 'material': {'default': 'general', 'title': 'Material', 'type': 'string', 'description': 'see tool description'}, 'top_k': {'default': 5, 'title': 'Top K', 'type': 'integer', 'description': 'see tool description'}, 'conditions': {'anyOf': [{'additionalProperties': True, 'type': 'object'}, {'type': 'null'}], 'default': None, 'title': 'Conditions', 'description': 'see tool description', 'type': 'string'}}
